title: Randomized value of a sign query check
statement: Let $C$ be a check consisting of a sign predicate and a Boolean-cube query for each input position, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube whose values lie in $[-1,1]$. Its randomized value is the probability that the predicate accepts when each query is independently replaced by a random sign with mean equal to the value of $f$ on that query.
hypotheses_covered: A sign predicate with one query for each predicate input
A bounded cube function with values in $[-1,1]
